card.name: Mid-sentence words in pathology descriptions
card.fires_on: Linking words and partway-through-word pieces inside descriptions of kidney, immune or brain pathology, such as 'and' after glomerular, 'the' after 'In some cases,', or the middle of idiopathic and amyloid.
